summary: Completed comprehensive backend testing of Design Saga ERP Accounting Module audit fixes. All 16 tests passed (100% success rate). Verified all P1/P2/P3 features including critical edge cases: payment reversal cascades, idempotency checks, RBAC permissions, commission receipts, loan deletion, opening balances, daybook pagination, today's collections, outstanding calculations, inactive accounts, auto account codes, and general correctness (all JEs balanced).
passed_tests: Edge Case: Reverse then re-pay (no duplicate JE) - Idempotency check filters out reversed=true JEs
Edge Case: DELETE linked JE fails with 409 - Correctly prevents deletion of invoice_payment JEs
Edge Case: Unbalanced JE fails with 400 - Validates DR = CR before posting
P1: Payment reversal cascades to invoice - Status reset to 'sent', journal_id cleared
P1: Milestone reversal cascades to milestone - Status reset to 'pending', journal_id cleared
P1: RBAC uses finance.* permissions - Accountant role can access accounting endpoints
P1: Commission receipt creates balanced JE - Includes project_id, vendor_id, source=commission_income
P1: Loan deletion archives + reverses JE - Loan archived, disbursement JE reversed (not deleted)
P1: Opening balances in Trial Balance & Balance Sheet - Both balanced (DR=CR=1,494,162, BS delta=0.0)
P2: Daybook filters + pagination - Supports limit/offset, filters (project/client/vendor/source/q), backward-compat
P2: Today's Collections includes invoice_payment - Counts invoice_payment/milestone_payment sources (total=63,717)
P2: Outstanding includes invoices + milestones - Unified calculation (unpaid invoices + pending milestones = 71,888)
P3: Hide inactive accounts by default - Soft-deleted accounts hidden, visible with include_inactive=1
P3: Auto account codes by type - Expense→4xxx, Income→3xxx, Liability→2xxx
P3: Commission vendor-wise report - Dashboard and report endpoints working
General: All JEs balanced (DR = CR) - Verified 56 journal entries, all balanced
